newsitem.title: USA: Conmed says sales change may hurt Q2.
newsitem.headline: Conmed says sales change may hurt Q2.

text.p: CONMED Corp said on Thursday that the consolidation of its sales force hurt its first quarter sales and that its second quarter sales may continue to be affected.
The manufacturer of medical products said it wanted to improve the efficiency of its sales force by having each representative selling a full range of products.
In the later half on 1997 and beyond, the company said it expects this change to enhance its sales efforts.
Conmed said it will eliminate certain end of quarter dealer price incentives which we have offered for a number of years, which will hurt second quarter sales by as much as $2.0 million.

However, after the second quarter, sales should return to normal levels as dealers utilize regular ordering patterns rather than relying on end of period purchases to meet hospital needs, the company said.
